## How was it tested?
- [ ] `pytest` (backend)
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` (frontend)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (if UI flows changed)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests (including a negative test for security rules)

## Checklist
- [ ] No real customer data, credentials or API keys
- [ ] Security decisions stay in backend code (not in prompts or the UI)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / ARCHITECTURE / SECURITY_MODEL / LEARNING_GUIDE) if behaviour changed
